description: Switch Claude Code or Codex logins when quota runs out, and start a new BB thread with a saved account. Check remaining limits before choosing an account, or add one through the provider's browser sign-in. Runs on macOS and Windows, with snapshots stored in Keychain or encrypted with Windows DPAPI; tokens go to Anthropic and OpenAI, while Cursor and other providers show limits only. Requires provider accounts; Codex switching also needs the Codex CLI signed in with ChatGPT, and saving Codex logins on macOS needs Xcode Command Line Tools.
